content.short: The Mallard Order is a secret society NFT collection on Cardano featuring the $RUNE ecosystem token.
content.description: The Mallard Order is an exclusive collection of 6,500 digital duck avatars that form a lore-driven 'secret society' on the Cardano blockchain. Holders can participate in a robust ecosystem by staking their Mallards to earn $RUNE, the project's primary utility token. The ecosystem also features 'Ancient Relics' and a dedicated comic series that expands the Dark Swamp universe. With access to private Discord channels, exclusive game nights, and real-world events, The Mallard Order offers a comprehensive experience that blends high-quality digital art with deep community engagement.
content.meta: The Mallard Order is an exclusive Cardano NFT society featuring $RUNE rewards and deep lore. Explore it now on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
